tasks.title: Document exported runtime-helper conventions
tasks.spec: ## Repository: kit — Files, proposed entry, existing-text/creation instructions, checks and completion evidence; Required behavior: The common entry; Acceptance evidence 1-3, 5-6; Non-goals, Risks and impact statements. Document reuse of the existing exports in docs/index.md#exports without changing those modules. Extend a helper with a parameter before adding a variant; helpers stay small and pure, with side effects passed as parameters. Preserve dist/. Add ## Code conventions directly after ## Code design; extend a section already present on current main instead of adding a duplicate.

acceptance.expected: prints exactly AGENTS.md; no product code, test, CI, dependency, README.md, version or generated-output changes
empty output, grep exits 1: no existing lines removed
prints 1 (at least one occurrence of the exact canonical meta URL is required)
prints exactly 200 for an unauthenticated request

Reading confirms: Add ## Code conventions directly after ## Code design; extend a section already present on current main instead of adding a duplicate. The entry names the existing exports in docs/index.md#exports; it requires searching before writing, extracting the second copy into a shared helper, and small pure functions with effects at the existing boundary. Common prose is at most three lines after the heading. It links the convention without copying its seven rules or examples, preserves all existing text and stricter rules, and adds no enforcement or refactor.
exit 0 using the existing unchanged package.json check script; report any unrelated baseline failure as a known limit without fixing out-of-scope files
no changed or untracked path except AGENTS.md (or empty output after committing); in particular no dist/, lockfile, test or tooling changes

The PR body names the issue and supplies the AGENTS.md-only diff, link/heading grep outputs, and the bun run check command and actual result. It records known limits; states documentation-only performance impact none expected and security impact no; and leaves Acceptance evidence 6 as a post-merge feature-close check with the main SHA and repeated link/meaning checks, without claiming it ran before merge.

acceptance.command: verified_main_sha=$(gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-kit/commits/main --jq .sha) && printf '%s\n' "$verified_main_sha" && gh api "repos/lorenzh/pulse-kit/contents/AGENTS.md?ref=$verified_main_sha" --jq .content | base64 --decode
acceptance.expected: Deferred until feature close after this target PR merges (not a pre-merge task gate): record the main commit SHA returned by GitHub and read AGENTS.md at that exact SHA. Repeat Acceptance evidence 2-3 on that content: canonical URL present at least once, exactly 1 Code conventions heading, URL HTTP 200, and the three meanings. This implements this target's part of Acceptance evidence 6.
